honesty: The game released today. No guide step here has been verified in game. Every guide below is built from the official trophy description alone and says so where a place or step is not pinned down. Never invent a location, mission step or collectible spot.
list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze
sources: Official trophy list on Exophase for every name, description and grade
PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count where a trophy tracks one

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops when the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order, story first, then the side strands, then the long grinds, and this lands last. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first story beat, so treat it as a one-pass moment: finish it before wandering off to side play. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, clear the chapter's side strands and any one-time mission trophies listed for it, because a chapter trophy only tells you the chapter is done, not that you can go back. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Keep a save before the chapter's final mission, so a missed one-time beat inside the chapter does not force a whole replay. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. This is the Vice City chapter, so expect the city side activities to open up here; bank the chapter's mission trophies as you meet them rather than rushing the finale. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. As the later chapter, its missions are the ones most likely to carry one-time story trophies, so check the missables board before each mission and save first. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Do not start it until the missables board is clear: anything tied to a story moment that you have not earned yet may be locked once the finale is done. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A named mission trophy means one specific playthrough moment, so save before starting it and finish it in full. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to gate the robberies around them, so clear the robbery trophies you can reach before this one if they are still open. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Finish it on your first pass through its chapter; a named mission trophy is the clearest sign of a moment you should not leave half done. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Save before it, as with every named mission trophy, and do not treat it as repeatable until a replay route is confirmed in game. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the airport, so expect a vehicle or aircraft beat inside it; finish the mission cleanly rather than experimenting mid-mission. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. An operation mission usually means a set-piece with its own rules, so save first and follow the mission's own objectives to the end. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which is the game's own checklist of story, side strands, collectibles and activities. Treat it as the last gold before the platinum: track the remaining pieces in this guide's checklist and leave nothing half finished. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's driving and air tricks, so fold them into normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting: jump, spin and land cleanly whenever the road gives you a ramp. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of everything early, in the order the game introduces them, so you learn which activities feed the longer grinds before committing to any one. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill grind, not a story beat: work through the challenges a few at a time, learn each one's timing, and only chase gold once you can clear it reliably. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count of 42; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Visit the locations in a loop and learn each course before racing it for the win; a location only counts once you have won there. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races count, not repeat wins, so rotate through new race types and locations instead of replaying your favourite. trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's challenge through the fishing activity, then play the challenge itself rather than free fishing: the trophy is about beating Cal, not about catching the most fish. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick the shortest arcade game you can find and play it to its end; completion, not a high score, is what the description asks for. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side strands end with a final mission, so keep playing Andy's strand whenever it appears and save before its finale. trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work Kenton's strand to its end before the finale; a strand's final mission is a one-time beat, so do not leave it for after the story ends. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand as it opens up, and keep a save before the last mission in case a choice inside it matters. trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its end and save before the finale, as with every strand final. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Clear Tyrone's strand before the final mission, and do not assume a strand stays open after the story ends. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand to the hunt itself; the trophy names a unique animal, so it is a specific hunt, not ordinary hunting. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards wherever you find them and keep sets together in the tracker; finishing a set, not just holding cards, is what counts. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is the long photo-style grind: use the WAiNK activity at new places as you travel, and let the count build across the whole playthrough. trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges overlap with the other grinds, so the count rises while you chase stunts, races and collectibles; check the challenge list often and finish the easy ones first. Sources: official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress count; guide advice from the official description only, not yet verified in game.

Plan a short route between three nearby shops, keep the wanted level alive between them, and move fast so it never drops.
